purpose: Verify HR-EIS operates under Fusion RBAC for actor permissions.
preconditions: Registered users with distinct roles (Employee, HR Admin, HOD, Director, Accountant).
action_or_input: Each actor accesses module endpoints authorized for their role.
expected_result: Requests succeed with HTTP 200/201 for authorized actors.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS enforces Fusion RBAC by denying unauthenticated requests to protected endpoints.
action_or_input: Attempt to access protected HR-EIS endpoints without authentication credentials.
expected_result: Request is rejected with HTTP 401 Unauthorized.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS supports users holding multiple roles simultaneously.
preconditions: User assigned both Employee and HOD roles.
action_or_input: User accesses employee self-service endpoints and approving authority endpoints.
expected_result: Both operations succeed under the respective active role permissions.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS respects institutional authority control over role assignment.
action_or_input: Verify HR-EIS does not permit standard users to self-assign administrative roles.
expected_result: Role assignments cannot be modified through standard HR-EIS endpoints.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS respects institutional authority control over role reassignment.
action_or_input: Verify role reassignment is restricted from routine HR request processing.
expected_result: Routine HR requests cannot alter or reassign user roles.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS restricts access to sensitive data to authorized roles only.
action_or_input: Employee attempts to access administrative settings or audit logs.
expected_result: Access denied with HTTP 403 Forbidden.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS restricts Employees to accessing only their own employee data.
preconditions: Two employees (Employee A and Employee B).
action_or_input: Employee A attempts to retrieve service records or claims belonging to Employee B.
expected_result: Access denied with HTTP 403 Forbidden or 404 Not Found.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS prevents unauthorized access to HR-EIS data.
action_or_input: User attempts to access restricted HR-EIS resources.
expected_result: Access denied with HTTP 403 Forbidden.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS prevents unauthorized modification of HR-EIS data.
action_or_input: Employee attempts to update official records or another user's requests.
expected_result: Modification rejected with HTTP 403 Forbidden.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS allows an Employee to submit HR-related requests.
preconditions: Authenticated employee with active service record.
action_or_input: Employee submits a new HR request (e.g. leave application).
expected_result: Request created successfully with HTTP 201 Created and status Submitted/Pending.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS allows an Employee to track statuses of HR-related requests submitted by the Employee.
action_or_input: Employee queries their submitted requests list.
expected_result: Returns list of employee's requests with current statuses.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS routes department-level approvals to the Head of Department where applicable.
preconditions: Department faculty/staff submits a request requiring department-level approval.
action_or_input: Submit request and verify assigned approval authority.
expected_result: Request is routed to HOD approval queue.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS routes non-teaching staff approvals to the Registrar where applicable.
preconditions: Non-teaching staff submits a request requiring institute authority approval.
action_or_input: Submit staff request and inspect routed authority.
expected_result: Request is routed to Registrar approval queue.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS routes faculty-level approvals to the Director where applicable.
preconditions: Faculty submits a request requiring final institute approval.
action_or_input: Submit faculty request and inspect routed authority.
expected_result: Request is routed to Director approval queue.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS determines approval authority strictly by employee category and request type.
preconditions: Configured authority routing matrix for Faculty vs Staff across request types.
action_or_input: Submit requests for Faculty vs Staff across distinct request types.
expected_result: Each request routes to the specific authority mandated by category and request type.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS routes all HR requests through rule-based workflows.
action_or_input: Verify request transitions and state machine progression.
expected_result: Request moves sequentially through rule-defined workflow states.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS supports the request outcome: Approved.
preconditions: Request pending review by authorized approving authority.
action_or_input: Authority approves the request with remarks.
expected_result: Request transitions to Approved (or progresses to next approval tier).

purpose: Verify HR-EIS supports the request outcome: Rejected.
preconditions: Request pending review by authorized approving authority.
action_or_input: Authority rejects the request with remarks.
expected_result: Request transitions to Rejected terminal state.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS supports the request outcome: Forwarded to next authority.
preconditions: Multi-tier request pending review by intermediate authority.
action_or_input: Authority forwards request to higher authority with remarks.
expected_result: Request transitions to Forwarded and current reviewer is updated.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS enforces authority roles using RBAC during HR request workflows.
preconditions: User without designated approving authority role for the request.
action_or_input: Attempt to approve, reject, or forward the request.
expected_result: Action rejected with HTTP 403 Forbidden.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS prevents any authority from bypassing workflow order.
preconditions: Multi-stage request currently at initial review tier.
action_or_input: Final authority attempts to approve prior to intermediate tier approval.
expected_result: Action rejected as out-of-order workflow transition.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS prevents any authority from altering workflow order.
action_or_input: Authority attempts to modify workflow sequence or skip configured steps.
expected_result: Workflow modification rejected; strict progression order enforced.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS does not allow manual bypass of approval workflows.
preconditions: Request in Submitted or Pending state.
action_or_input: Attempt to transition request directly to Settled or Approved without passing required approval steps.
expected_result: State transition rejected; workflow cannot be manually bypassed.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS allows HR Administrator to manage employee master and service records.
action_or_input: HR Admin creates or updates an employee service record.
expected_result: Record created/updated successfully with HTTP 200/201.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS allows HR Administrator to verify HR requests.
action_or_input: HR Admin verifies documents and records verification outcome.
expected_result: Verification outcome recorded and request status updated.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS allows HR Administrator to configure HR workflows within HR-EIS scope.
action_or_input: HR Admin updates workflow configuration settings.
expected_result: Workflow settings updated successfully with HTTP 200.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS allows HR Administrator to assign appraisal reviewers.
preconditions: Submitted appraisal form in active cycle.
action_or_input: HR Admin assigns reviewers to the appraisal.
expected_result: Reviewers assigned successfully with HTTP 200.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS allows HR Administrator to monitor compliance and audits using authorized records.
action_or_input: HR Admin queries audit log and compliance records.
expected_result: Audit records returned with HTTP 200.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS allows Accountant to process approved LTC claims for financial settlement recording.
preconditions: LTC claim approved by all designated authorities.
action_or_input: Accountant records financial settlement on the approved LTC claim.
expected_result: Settlement recorded with HTTP 200 and claim status updated to Settled.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS allows Accountant to process approved CPDA claims for financial settlement recording.
preconditions: CPDA claim approved by all designated authorities.
action_or_input: Accountant records financial settlement on the approved CPDA claim.
expected_result: Settlement recorded with HTTP 200 and claim status updated to Settled.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS allows Accountant to verify financial correctness of LTC and CPDA claims.
action_or_input: Accountant verifies claim amounts against entitlement limits and receipts.
expected_result: Financial verification status recorded; discrepancies can flag or return claim.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS records payment or disbursement status for approved financial claims when received from payroll or finance systems.
action_or_input: Record payment reference, date, and status on the claim.
expected_result: Payment details saved and status updated to Disbursed/Paid.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS allows an Employee to view the Employee's own service records.
preconditions: Authenticated employee with active service record.
action_or_input: Employee requests personal service record.
expected_result: Service record returned with HTTP 200 containing employee profile details.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS maintains a centralized service record for each employee.
action_or_input: Query centralized service record by employee ID.
expected_result: Centralized service record retrieved with all core employee data.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS includes appointment details in the employee service record.
preconditions: Service record created with appointment information.
action_or_input: Inspect appointment details in service record.
expected_result: Appointment date and appointment type fields are present.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS includes department in the employee service record.
action_or_input: Inspect department field in service record.
expected_result: Department field is present and accurate.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS includes designation in the employee service record.
action_or_input: Inspect designation field in service record.
expected_result: Designation field is present and accurate.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS includes service history in the employee service record.
preconditions: Service record with service history milestones.
action_or_input: Retrieve service history entries for employee.
expected_result: Service history entries returned in chronological order.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS includes leave balances in the employee service record.
preconditions: Service record with allocated leave balances.
action_or_input: Retrieve leave balance summary from service record.
expected_result: Leave balances for supported leave types are returned.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS includes retirement status in the employee service record.
action_or_input: Inspect retirement status field in service record.
expected_result: Retirement status field is present and retrievable.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS restricts creation of employee service records to HR Administrators.
action_or_input: Non-HR user attempts to POST a new service record.
expected_result: Creation rejected with HTTP 403 Forbidden.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS restricts modification of employee service records to HR Administrators.
action_or_input: Non-HR user attempts to PUT/PATCH an existing service record.
expected_result: Modification rejected with HTTP 403 Forbidden.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS allows Employees to view their own service records in read-only mode.
action_or_input: Employee retrieves service record via GET request.
expected_result: Record retrieved with HTTP 200; employee cannot alter data directly.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS preserves service record consistency during updates.
preconditions: HR Admin updating multiple fields on service record.
action_or_input: HR Admin submits valid partial or full update payload.
expected_result: Updated fields saved consistently without corrupting related attributes.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS prevents partial updates from corrupting service records.
preconditions: HR Admin submitting payload with invalid data failing schema/validation.
action_or_input: Submit update with invalid field values.
expected_result: Transaction aborted; original service record state preserved completely.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS does not permit Employees to alter official service records.
preconditions: Employee attempting to alter leave balances or designation directly.
action_or_input: Employee sends PUT/PATCH request to their own service record.
expected_result: Update rejected with HTTP 403 Forbidden.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS allows Employees to apply for leave requests.
action_or_input: Employee submits valid leave application.
expected_result: Leave application created with HTTP 201 and status Submitted.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS supports Casual leave as an available leave request type.
action_or_input: Submit leave request with leave_type='CASUAL'.
expected_result: Casual leave request accepted.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS supports Restricted leave as an available leave request type.
action_or_input: Submit leave request with leave_type='RESTRICTED'.
expected_result: Restricted leave request accepted.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS supports Medical leave as an available leave request type.
action_or_input: Submit leave request with leave_type='MEDICAL'.
expected_result: Medical leave request accepted.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS supports Earned leave as an available leave request type.
action_or_input: Submit leave request with leave_type='EARNED'.
expected_result: Earned leave request accepted.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS supports Vacation leave as an available leave request type.
preconditions: Faculty member eligible for Vacation leave.
action_or_input: Submit leave request with leave_type='VACATION'.
expected_result: Vacation leave request accepted.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS supports Sabbatical leave as an available leave request type.
preconditions: Faculty member eligible for Sabbatical leave.
action_or_input: Submit leave request with leave_type='SABBATICAL'.
expected_result: Sabbatical leave request accepted.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS requires each leave request to specify leave type.
action_or_input: Submit leave request payload missing leave_type field.
expected_result: Validation error returned with HTTP 400; submission rejected.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS requires each leave request to specify duration / dates.
action_or_input: Submit leave request payload missing start_date or end_date.
expected_result: Validation error returned with HTTP 400; submission rejected.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS requires each leave request to specify justification.
action_or_input: Submit leave request payload with blank or missing justification.
expected_result: Validation error returned with HTTP 400; submission rejected.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS validates employee leave balance before accepting a leave request submission.
preconditions: Employee with 2 days Casual leave remaining.
action_or_input: Employee applies for 5 days of Casual leave.
expected_result: Submission rejected with HTTP 400 due to insufficient balance.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS validates employee leave eligibility before accepting a leave request submission.
preconditions: Non-teaching staff employee applying for faculty-only leave (Vacation/Sabbatical).
action_or_input: Submit leave request in ineligible category.
expected_result: Submission rejected with HTTP 400 due to ineligibility.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS routes leave requests through a predefined approval hierarchy.
action_or_input: Inspect assigned approval authority on created leave request.
expected_result: Leave request is assigned to applicant's HOD / reporting authority.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS updates leave balances automatically when leave is approved.
preconditions: Employee has 10 days Casual leave; 3-day leave request is pending approval.
action_or_input: Approving authority approves the leave request.
expected_result: Leave balance is automatically decremented to 7 days.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS permanently logs all leave transactions.
action_or_input: Query audit log for leave events.
expected_result: Permanent audit records exist recording submission and approval decisions.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS allows Employees to submit yearly appraisal forms.
action_or_input: Employee submits self-appraisal form.
expected_result: Appraisal submitted successfully with HTTP 201 and status Submitted.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS restricts yearly appraisal form submission to configured submission windows.
action_or_input: Employee attempts to submit appraisal form outside active window.
expected_result: Submission rejected with HTTP 400/403 stating window is closed.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS allows HR Administrator to assign reviewers for appraisal evaluation.
preconditions: Submitted appraisal form in active cycle.
action_or_input: HR Admin assigns reviewers to the appraisal.
expected_result: Reviewers assigned and appraisal status updated to Under Review.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS routes appraisal workflows through designated authorities for review and finalization.
action_or_input: Director / final authority finalizes appraisal evaluation.
expected_result: Appraisal progresses to Finalized / Closed status.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS archives finalized appraisals in the employee service record.
action_or_input: Inspect employee service record for appraisal history.
expected_result: Finalized appraisal is archived and visible in service record.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS prevents modification of appraisal records after closure.
action_or_input: Attempt to edit or delete finalized appraisal form.
expected_result: Modification rejected; record is immutable after closure.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS allows Employees to submit LTC advance requests using prescribed forms.
preconditions: Eligible employee applying for LTC advance.
action_or_input: Employee submits LTC advance request with travel dates and estimated fare.
expected_result: LTC advance request created with HTTP 201 and status Submitted.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS allows Employees to submit LTC reimbursement requests using prescribed forms.
action_or_input: Employee submits LTC reimbursement request with actual expenses.
expected_result: LTC reimbursement request created with HTTP 201 and status Submitted.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS allows HR Administrator to verify LTC documentation.
action_or_input: HR Admin verifies tickets, declaration, and receipts.
expected_result: Documentation verification status recorded on claim.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS allows HR Administrator to verify LTC eligibility.
action_or_input: HR Admin verifies block period entitlement and quota.
expected_result: Eligibility verification status recorded on claim.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS routes verified LTC requests through the approval hierarchy.
preconditions: LTC claim verified by HR Admin.
action_or_input: Inspect claim status and reviewer queue after verification.
expected_result: Claim is routed to designated approving authority (Registrar/Director).

purpose: Verify HR-EIS allows Accountant to process approved LTC claims for financial settlement recording.
preconditions: LTC claim approved by designated authority.
action_or_input: Accountant records financial settlement on the approved claim.
expected_result: Claim status updated to Settled with HTTP 200.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS records payment status for LTC claims.
action_or_input: Record payment reference and disbursement status.
expected_result: Payment status updated to Disbursed/Paid.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS links LTC payment status to payroll systems without modifying payroll rules.
action_or_input: Inspect payroll sync reference on LTC claim.
expected_result: Payroll sync link recorded while payroll rules remain unmodified.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS retains full audit history for rejected LTC requests.
preconditions: LTC request in verification or approval queue.
action_or_input: Authority rejects LTC request with reason.
expected_result: Audit record created documenting rejection reason; status is Rejected.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS retains full audit history for returned LTC requests.
preconditions: LTC request in verification or approval queue.
action_or_input: Reviewer returns LTC request for correction with remarks.
expected_result: Audit record created documenting return action and remarks.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS allows Employees to submit CPDA advance requests.
preconditions: Faculty employee with available CPDA allocation.
action_or_input: Employee submits CPDA advance request with event details and amount.
expected_result: CPDA advance request created with HTTP 201 and status Submitted.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS allows Employees to submit CPDA reimbursement requests.
preconditions: Faculty employee with incurred academic expenses.
action_or_input: Employee submits CPDA reimbursement request with receipts.
expected_result: CPDA reimbursement request created with HTTP 201 and status Submitted.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS requires each CPDA request to include purpose.
action_or_input: Submit CPDA request without purpose/activity.
expected_result: Validation error returned with HTTP 400; submission rejected.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS requires each CPDA request to include amount.
action_or_input: Submit CPDA request with missing or non-positive amount.
expected_result: Validation error returned with HTTP 400; submission rejected.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS requires each CPDA request to include supporting documents.
action_or_input: Submit CPDA request without required supporting documentation.
expected_result: Validation error returned with HTTP 400; submission rejected.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS allows HR Administrator to verify CPDA claims before approval routing.
action_or_input: HR Admin verifies purpose, amount, and documents.
expected_result: Verification outcome recorded and claim moves to approval queue.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS routes verified CPDA claims through approval routing.
preconditions: CPDA claim verified by HR Admin.
action_or_input: Check destination authority for verified CPDA claim.
expected_result: Claim is routed to designated approving authority (HOD/Director).

purpose: Verify HR-EIS allows Accountant to process approved CPDA claims.
preconditions: CPDA claim approved by designated authority.
action_or_input: Accountant records financial settlement on the approved claim.
expected_result: Claim status updated to Settled with HTTP 200.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS records CPDA disbursement details.
action_or_input: Record disbursement amount, date, and reference.
expected_result: Disbursement details saved on the claim record.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS makes CPDA disbursement records auditable.
action_or_input: Query audit logs for disbursement transaction.
expected_result: Audit record exists detailing actor, timestamp, and disbursement info.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS notifies an Employee about relevant HR request and policy/deadline events.
action_or_input: Query notifications for the recipient employee.
expected_result: Notification record retrieved for the employee.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS generates notifications for request submission.
action_or_input: Submit HR request and inspect generated notifications.
expected_result: Submission notification generated for applicant and reviewing authority.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS generates notifications for approval, rejection, or forwarding.
action_or_input: Authority approves, rejects, or forwards the request.
expected_result: Notification generated for applicant communicating decision.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS generates notifications for pending action reminders.
action_or_input: Trigger pending action reminder schedule or service.
expected_result: Reminder notification generated for the assigned reviewer.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS generates notifications for policy or deadline updates.
preconditions: Appraisal deadline or policy event announced.
action_or_input: Broadcast policy or deadline update notification.
expected_result: Deadline update notification created for target users.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS delivers notifications through the system dashboard.
action_or_input: User queries dashboard notifications endpoint.
expected_result: Notification is retrievable via dashboard notifications API.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS delivers notifications through official email dispatch channel.
action_or_input: Verify email dispatch record or mocked mail dispatch queue.
expected_result: Email dispatch event recorded with recipient and subject.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS logs every HR transaction.
action_or_input: Query audit logs.
expected_result: Transaction is captured in audit log table.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS audit logs include actor identity.
action_or_input: Inspect audit log entry for the performed action.
expected_result: Actor ID/username is stored in the audit log.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS audit logs include timestamp.
action_or_input: Inspect audit log entry.
expected_result: Valid timestamp is recorded in the audit log.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS audit logs include action performed.

expected_result: Action description/verb is recorded in the audit log.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS audit logs are immutable.

expected_result: Modification or deletion rejected; logs remain immutable.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS restricts audit log access to authorized roles only.
action_or_input: Employee queries audit logs endpoint.
expected_result: Access denied with HTTP 403 Forbidden.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS supports compliance with institutional HR and financial policies through logged HR-EIS transactions.
preconditions: Audit records present for HR transactions.
action_or_input: HR Admin queries filtered audit records for compliance reporting.
expected_result: Filtered audit trail returned for compliance verification.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS integrates with the payroll system for disbursement-status exchange related to approved claims.
preconditions: Approved claim ready for payroll sync.
action_or_input: Execute payroll disbursement sync contract.
expected_result: Disbursement status exchanged with payroll interface.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS integrates with the finance system for accounting-status exchange related to approved claims.
preconditions: Approved claim ready for financial accounting sync.
action_or_input: Execute finance accounting sync contract.
expected_result: Accounting status exchanged with finance interface.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS integrates with other Fusion modules for identity and role consistency.
action_or_input: Verify HR-EIS employee service records maintain consistent linkage to Fusion user identities.
expected_result: Identity and role consistency maintained across module boundaries.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS synchronizes integration data automatically and in real time where configured.
preconditions: Automatic synchronization configured for claim settlement.
action_or_input: Record claim settlement.
expected_result: Integration sync event triggered automatically in real time.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS respects payroll boundary by not modifying payroll rules.
action_or_input: Verify HR-EIS does not expose endpoints or services to modify external payroll rules.
expected_result: Payroll rule modification is strictly out of scope for HR-EIS.

purpose: Verify HR-EIS respects salary-structure boundary by not modifying salary structures.
